selectionBasis: visual inspection of exact candidate-render-1 temporal contact sheet before any research-arm generation

revisions.diagnosedShortcoming: The recurrent mass was coherent but the required persistent internal void was not legible enough across the horizon.
revisions.concept: Retain coupled recurrence, then use a radial-gap projection plus asymmetric cross-shear so the central void is causal without reducing the form to a ring.

revisions.diagnosedShortcoming: Candidate 1 collapsed to a tiny mark at the second sampled time, violating stable braid behavior.
revisions.concept: Use a time-stable coupled attractor kernel and put the temporal drift in two non-rigid iteration-dependent projection terms instead of destabilizing the recurrence coefficients.

revisions.diagnosedShortcoming: Candidate 1 remained an amorphous recurrent mass; the requested three related but unequal lobes were not structurally explicit.
revisions.concept: Project one shared recurrent kernel into exactly three slowly precessing copies with unequal scales, making the lobe relationship explicit while preserving one recurrent mathematical cause.

revisions.diagnosedShortcoming: The breathing gap was visible, but the projection approached a simple oval/ring at several times, contrary to the brief.
revisions.concept: Keep the causal breathing radial gap but add anisotropic scale and cross-shear so recurrent interior structure persists instead of becoming a simple circle.
